# Removing RJ: what happens to each row

| Row | Class | Why |
|---|---|---|
| S-8 | inherit | a cluster outage still stops whoever replays |
| S-9 | vanish | the job's misuse goes with the job |
| S-10 | morph | throttling reaches on-call's manual replay differently |

- S-12: vanish — operators needed a route into the cluster only for the job
